fact: The government adopted the draft digital norms and standards for the public sector on 15 April 2022, in five books including a common data-reference architecture framework and the general interoperability framework, with legal force still to be given by ministerial order.
system: Normes et standards du numérique applicable au secteur public

fact: A ministry workshop on 2-3 February 2022 validated five books of public-sector digital standards, including a data-reference architecture framework and a general interoperability framework meant to give real-time interoperability of public information systems, still to be tidied and promulgated.
